body: apps/arena appends match_start/snapshot(500ms)/ability_cast/match_end JSON lines to var/matches/arena-<timestamp>.jsonl, fresh file per match including on restart. No connect-ticket auth in this client -- events use local_player/local_bot placeholders, flagged as a real gap rather than a guessed identity. Verified by clean compile (scripts/build_arena.sh) + code review only, no display on this box so unlike the RTS half this couldn't be run end-to-end. test_arena.sh still green. Commit 4327393. BACKLOG S170-29. Phase B now closed both halves.
